documents.text:
# About Fernhollow

Fernhollow Labs Ltd was founded in 2017 and is headquartered in Galway, Ireland, with further offices in Lisbon, Portugal and Toronto, Canada.

We run three businesses under one roof and one support team:

- **Fernhollow Workspace**: team software with five modules: Inbox, Reports, Admin panel, API and Mobile app.
- **Fernhollow Store**: office gear, including standing desks, office chairs, monitor stands, keyboards, headphones and merchandise such as mugs and jackets.
- **Fernhollow Academy**: online courses and live training for teams.

## Contact

| For | Contact |
|---|---|
| Support | support@fernhollow.example |
| Partnerships | partners@fernhollow.example |
| Privacy and data requests | privacy@fernhollow.example |
| Service status | status.fernhollow.example |

## Careers

We are hiring for these roles:

- Support Engineer (Galway)
- Support Engineer (Lisbon)
- Frontend Engineer (Toronto)

Apply at fernhollow.example/careers.

documents.name: academy-courses.md
documents.text:
# Fernhollow Academy courses

| Course | Lessons | Price |
|---|---|---|
| Inbox Zero for Teams | 12 | €149 |
| Reporting That Gets Read | 8 | €99 |
| Admin Essentials | 10 | €129 |

## Access

You have access to a course for 12 months from purchase.

## Certificates

A certificate is issued when you complete every lesson and pass the final quiz with at least 80%.

## Team licences

Buying 5 or more seats of one course gives 20% off.

The student discount does not apply to the Academy.

For live onboarding sessions with a trainer, see *Live onboarding for teams*.

documents.name: academy-refunds.md
documents.text:
# Academy refunds

You can get a refund for a course within 14 days of purchase, as long as you have completed less than 25% of its lessons.

For example, Inbox Zero for Teams has 12 lessons, so it can be refunded until you have completed 3 of them.

After 14 days, or once 25% of the lessons are completed, courses are not refundable.

documents.name: billing-invoices-and-vat.md
documents.text:
# Invoices and VAT

## When invoices are issued

Invoices are issued on the 1st of each month for monthly plans, and on the renewal date for annual plans.

## Downloading invoices

Any past invoice can be downloaded as PDF or CSV from **Admin panel > Billing > Invoices**, including itemised invoices for a past quarter.

## VAT

EU business customers with a valid VAT ID are invoiced with reverse-charge VAT.

The VAT ID must be on the account before the invoice is issued. Invoices older than 60 days are not reissued, so add your VAT ID as soon as possible and contact support promptly if an invoice shows the wrong VAT.

## Billing contact

The workspace owner changes the billing contact in **Admin panel > Billing > Contacts**.

documents.name: billing-payments.md
documents.text:
# Payment methods and failed payments

## Payment methods

| For | Accepted |
|---|---|
| Workspace | card; bank transfer for annual Enterprise only |
| Store | card, PayPal |

PayPal is not accepted for Workspace subscriptions.

## Updating your card

Update the card in **Admin panel > Billing > Payment method**. The new card is charged on the next invoice, not immediately.

## Failed payments

If a payment fails, we retry 3 times over 10 days. If all retries fail, the workspace is downgraded to Free. Nothing is deleted.

## Duplicate charges

A duplicate card charge is refunded to the card within 5 business days of being reported.

## Recognising our charges

Charges appear on card statements as FERNHOLLOW* followed by WORKSPACE, STORE or ACADEMY.

documents.name: billing-plan-changes.md
documents.text:
# Changing plans and billing periods

## Downgrading

A downgrade takes effect at the end of the current billing period. Data over the new plan's limits becomes read-only; nothing is deleted.

If you were charged after downgrading to Free, the charge is refunded in full to the card, provided the downgrade was confirmed before the invoice date.

## Monthly to annual

Switching from monthly to annual billing takes effect immediately. The unused part of the monthly payment is credited.

## Annual to monthly

Switching from annual to monthly billing takes effect at the annual renewal date.

## Price changes

We give 60 days' notice by email before a price increase.

The Pro price changed on 2026-03-01. Existing Pro customers keep the old price until their first renewal on or after 2026-06-01. See *Workspace plans and pricing*.

documents.name: billing-promo-codes.md
documents.text:
# Promo codes

If you forgot to enter a promo code at checkout, support can apply it within 14 days of purchase. Email support@fernhollow.example with the order or invoice number and the code.

# Feature requests and the roadmap

Our public roadmap is at fernhollow.example/roadmap and is updated quarterly.

documents.name: internal-support-runbook.md
documents.text:
# INTERNAL: Support runbook

For the support team only. Not customer-facing.

## Queues

Every ticket goes to exactly one queue: billing, shipping, refund, bug, account, retention, escalation or other.

## Escalate immediately

Send a ticket to **escalation** when any of these is true:

- It is a Severity 1 incident: the Workspace, or a module for all users in a workspace, is unavailable, or data is exposed to the wrong account.
- It is a bug or outage reported by an Enterprise customer who already has 2 or more open tickets.
- Anyone reports data visible to the wrong account.

## Retention, not refund

A refund request from a customer on a contract that renews within 60 days goes to **retention**, not refund. Look the customer up before routing any refund request.

## Enterprise response times

Severity 1: first response within 2 hours, 24/7. Everything else: within 4 business hours. Business hours are 09:00-18:00 Irish time, Monday to Friday, excluding Irish public holidays.

## Status page

Post incident updates to status.fernhollow.example.

documents.name: store-delivery-problems.md
documents.text:
# Delivery problems

## Missed delivery

The courier attempts delivery twice, then holds the parcel at the depot for 7 days, then returns it to us. An order returned to us is refunded minus the original shipping charge.

## Part of my order is missing

Boxes from one order can ship up to 2 business days apart. If a box is still missing 3 business days after the first one arrived, report it.

## Marked delivered but not received

Wait 48 hours, then file a claim within 14 days of the delivery date.

## Left in the wrong place

Report it within 48 hours. The courier has 5 business days to recover the parcel before we send a replacement.

## Damaged parcel

Report damage within 7 days of delivery, with photos of the box and the item.

## Tracking has not updated

If tracking has not updated for 5 business days, we open an investigation with the courier.

## Late delivery

An order that arrives more than 10 business days after its delivery estimate can be returned free of charge.

documents.name: store-order-changes.md
documents.text:
# Changing an order

## Upgrading to express

You can upgrade an order to express until its status is **Packed**. Express is available to Ireland, the UK, the US and Canada.

## Changing the delivery address

You can change the delivery address until the order status is **Packed**.

## Holding an order

An order that has not shipped can be held for up to 14 days. Once shipped, the courier can hold a parcel at the depot for up to 7 days.

documents.text:
# Return shipping and furniture pickup

## Return labels

| Destination | Label cost |
|---|---|
| EU | €8.95 |
| UK | £7.95 |
| US and Canada | $9.95 |

The label is free when the item is defective or the wrong item was sent.

documents.name: store-returns-policy.md
documents.text:
# Store returns policy (v2)

**Version 2, effective 2025-07-01.** This policy replaces version 1 (effective 2024-01-15 to 2025-06-30).

## Return window

You can return a Store item within **45 days from delivery**.

Items must be unused and in their original packaging, unless the item is defective or we sent the wrong item.

Items marked Clearance are final sale and cannot be returned.

## Restocking fee

A 10% restocking fee applies to non-defective returns of standing desks and office chairs.

## Return shipping

Return labels cost €8.95 in the EU, £7.95 in the UK and $9.95 in the US and Canada. The label is free when the item is defective or the wrong item was sent. Standing desks and office chairs are collected by courier: see *Return shipping and furniture pickup*.

## Refunds

Refunds go to the original payment method and are issued within 5 business days of the warehouse receiving the return. Your bank may take up to 10 more business days.

Defective items are covered by the warranty: see *Store warranty*.

documents.name: store-shipping.md
documents.text:
# Store shipping: where, how long, how much

We ship from warehouses in Galway, Ireland and Mississauga, Canada to Ireland, the rest of the EU, the UK, the US and Canada. We do not ship anywhere else.

## Standard delivery times

| Destination | Standard delivery |
|---|---|
| Ireland | 2-3 business days |
| Rest of the EU | 3-6 business days |
| UK | 3-5 business days |
| Canada | 3-7 business days |
| US | 4-8 business days |

## Free shipping

Standard shipping is free on orders over €75 in the EU and the UK, and over $85 in the US and Canada.

## Express

Express delivery is available to Ireland, the UK, the US and Canada, but not to the rest of the EU. It arrives the next business day in Ireland and in 2 business days elsewhere. Order by 13:00 warehouse local time.

documents.name: store-warranty.md
documents.text:
# Store warranty

| Category | Warranty |
|---|---|
| Standing desks, office chairs, monitor stands | 2 years |
| Keyboards, headphones | 1 year |
| Merchandise (mugs, jackets) | no warranty beyond the return window |

## If an item is defective

- **Within the first 30 days:** a refund or a replacement, your choice.
- **After 30 days:** a repair or a replacement only. Refunds are not available after the first 30 days.

The return label is free for defective items.

documents.name: support-and-response-times.md
documents.text:
# Getting support

## First response times

| Plan | Channel and first response |
|---|---|
| Free | community forum only |
| Basic | email, 2 business days |
| Pro | email and chat, 8 business hours |
| Enterprise | 2 hours, 24/7 for Severity 1; 4 business hours for everything else |

Business hours are 09:00-18:00 Irish time, Monday to Friday, excluding Irish public holidays.

## Severity 1

A Severity 1 incident is one where the Workspace, or a module for all users in a workspace, is unavailable, or data is exposed to the wrong account.

## Service status

Check status.fernhollow.example before contacting us about an outage.

documents.name: workspace-admin-users-and-ownership.md
documents.text:
# Managing users and ownership

## Removing a user

Admins remove a user immediately in **Admin panel > Users**. The user's active sessions end within 5 minutes. Use this when someone leaves your organisation.

## Requiring 2FA

Admins on Pro and Enterprise can require two-factor authentication for all users.

## Transferring ownership

The workspace owner transfers ownership in **Admin panel > Workspace > Owner**. The new owner must already be an admin.

## Merging two workspaces

Support can merge two workspaces only if both are on the same plan and one of them has 5 or fewer users.

documents.name: workspace-api.md
documents.text:
# The Workspace API

The API is available on Basic, Pro and Enterprise. The Free plan has no API access.

## Rate limits

| Plan | Limit |
|---|---|
| Basic | 60 requests per minute |
| Pro | 600 requests per minute |
| Enterprise | 3,000 requests per minute |

A request over the limit receives HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header giving the wait in seconds.

## Documentation

The API documentation is available in English only. The Workspace interface itself is available in English, Spanish, Portuguese and French.

documents.name: workspace-cancellation-and-refunds.md
documents.text:
# Cancelling Workspace and refunds

## Monthly plans

Cancellation takes effect at the end of the month. There are no refunds for partial months.

## Annual plans

- **Within 14 days of the annual purchase:** a full refund to the original payment method.
- **After 14 days:** a prorated refund of the unused time, as account credit only. Refunds after the first 14 days are never paid to the card.

## Charged after downgrading

A charge made after a downgrade to Free is refunded in full to the card if the downgrade was confirmed before the invoice date.

Store and Academy purchases have their own refund rules: see *Store returns policy* and *Academy refunds*.

documents.name: workspace-data-export.md
documents.text:
# Exporting your data

Workspace data can be exported as CSV or JSON.

A yearly summary export is not available.

documents.name: workspace-data-residency-and-security.md
documents.text:
# Data residency and security

## Where your data is stored

Workspace data is hosted in one of two regions:

- EU (Frankfurt)
- US (Virginia)

Enterprise customers choose the region. On every other plan, the workspace is placed by the billing country at signup and cannot move.

## SOC 2

Our SOC 2 Type II report is available under NDA to Pro and Enterprise customers through the trust portal at fernhollow.example/trust.

documents.name: workspace-data-retention-and-deletion.md
documents.text:
# Data retention and deletion

## Trash

Deleted messages and files stay in trash for 21 days. After that they cannot be restored.

## Deleting your account

To delete an account and all its data, email privacy@fernhollow.example from the account's email address.

- The deletion is complete within 45 days of the request.
- Backups are purged within 90 days of the request.

documents.name: workspace-languages-browsers-apps.md
documents.text:
# Languages, browsers and apps

## Interface languages

The Workspace interface is available in English, Spanish, Portuguese and French. The API documentation is available in English only.

## Supported browsers

We support the latest two versions of Chrome, Firefox and Edge, and Safari 17 or later.

## Mobile app

The Mobile app runs on iOS 17 or later and Android 12 or later. Mobile app sessions expire after 30 days of inactivity.

documents.name: workspace-plans-and-pricing.md
documents.text:
# Workspace plans and pricing

Fernhollow Workspace comes in four plans: Free, Basic, Pro and Enterprise. Prices are per seat.

| | Free | Basic | Pro | Enterprise |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Price (monthly billing) | $0 | $9 per seat per month | $19 per seat per month | custom quote |
| Price (annual billing) | $0 | $90 per seat per year | $190 per seat per year | custom quote |
| Users | up to 3 | per seat | per seat | minimum 25 seats |
| Free guests per workspace | - | 0 | 10 | 50 |
| Maximum file upload | 10 MB | 25 MB | 100 MB | 250 MB |
| Storage | 2 GB total for the workspace | 5 GB per seat | 20 GB per seat | 100 GB per seat |
| API access | no | 60 requests per minute | 600 requests per minute | 3,000 requests per minute |
| Reports history | 30 days | 12 months | 36 months | unlimited |
| Google SSO | - | - | yes | yes |
| SAML SSO | - | - | - | yes |
| Uptime commitment | none | none | 99.9% monthly | 99.95% monthly |
| First response from support | community forum only | email, 2 business days | email and chat, 8 business hours | 2 hours, 24/7 for Severity 1; 4 business hours otherwise |

Guests beyond your plan's free allowance are billed as full seats. See *Seats and guests*.

## Pro price change

Pro prices changed on 2026-03-01, from $17 to $19 per seat per month and from $170 to $190 per seat per year. Existing Pro customers keep the old price until their first renewal on or after 2026-06-01.

documents.name: workspace-seats-and-guests.md
documents.text:
# Seats and guests

Every Basic, Pro and Enterprise workspace is billed per seat. A seat is one user.

## Guests

Guests are people outside your organisation who you invite into a workspace. Each plan includes a free guest allowance per workspace:

- Basic: 0 free guests
- Pro: 10 free guests
- Enterprise: 50 free guests

**Each guest beyond the plan's free allowance is billed as a full seat.** A Pro workspace with 14 guests pays for 4 extra seats.

## Adding seats

Seats added mid-term are billed prorated to the end of the current term.

## Removing seats

- **Monthly plans:** removing a seat takes effect at the next monthly invoice. There is no partial-month credit.
- **Annual plans:** removed seats are credited only at renewal, not mid-term.

If your invoice shows more seats than you have active users, check your guest count first: guests over the allowance appear on the invoice as seats.

documents.name: workspace-sla.md
documents.text:
# Uptime commitment (SLA)

| Plan | Monthly uptime commitment |
|---|---|
| Free | none |
| Basic | none |
| Pro | 99.9% |
| Enterprise | 99.95% |

## Service credits

If monthly uptime falls below your plan's commitment, you are entitled to a credit:

- below the commitment: 10% of that month's fee;
- below 99.0%: 25% of that month's fee.

Credits must be claimed within 30 days of the end of the affected month. Contact support@fernhollow.example.

Current service status is at status.fernhollow.example.

documents.name: workspace-sso-and-two-factor.md
documents.text:
# Single sign-on and two-factor authentication

## Single sign-on

- **Google SSO** is available on Pro and Enterprise.
- **SAML SSO** is available on Enterprise only. It was added on 2026-04-22.

## Two-factor authentication (2FA)

Every plan can use an authenticator app (TOTP) for 2FA.

SMS backup codes are available only in the US, Canada, the UK and Ireland. Elsewhere, use an authenticator app.

Admins on Pro and Enterprise can require 2FA for all users in their workspace.

documents.name: workspace-training-and-onboarding.md
documents.text:
# Live onboarding for teams

Live onboarding sessions are 90 minutes long, for up to 20 attendees.

- **Enterprise:** 2 live onboarding sessions are included.
- **Pro:** sessions can be purchased at €450 per session.

For self-paced courses, see Fernhollow Academy.
